info.title: AirCloud External API
info.description: Public REST API for managing AirCloud endpoints and Jobs programmatically.

tags.name: Endpoints
tags.description: Manage endpoints: list, start, stop, scale, and patch.

tags.name: Volumes
tags.description: List volumes that Jobs can mount.

tags.name: Instance Types
tags.description: List instance types available for Jobs.

get.description: Returns the organization, project, and user mapped to the current API key.
Returns a paginated list of endpoints accessible by the current API key.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID to filter by. Optional — it must match the API key's project; any other value returns 403.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Filter by active status. `true` returns only running endpoints, `false` returns only stopped endpoints.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Min 1, max 2000.

get.description: Returns the current status of an endpoint. Includes replica status summary when active.

403.description: Endpoint does not belong to your organization or project.

patch.description: Update runtime settings for an inactive endpoint. At least one field must be provided. Stop the endpoint first if it is active.

requestBody.description: Fields to update. All fields are optional, but at least one must be provided.

409.description: Endpoint is active. Stop it first.

post.description: Start an inactive endpoint. The organization must have sufficient credit balance. The endpoint must be active before scaling replicas.

500.description: Failed to start (insufficient balance, resource allocation failure, etc.).

post.description: Scale the number of replicas for an active endpoint. Autoscaling must be disabled.

400.description: Endpoint is inactive or autoscaling is enabled.

get.description: Returns live replica details for an active endpoint.
Returns available log files for an endpoint. Supports filtering by replica and history.

parameters.name: replica_id
parameters.description: Filter logs by a specific replica ID.

parameters.name: include_history
parameters.description: Set to `false` to exclude rotated historical logs and return only current active logs.

get.description: Returns the content of a specific log file by line range.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.description: Node ID where the log file is located. Use the `node_id` value from the `/logs` response.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Log file path. Use the `filename` value from the `/logs` response.

post.description:
Submit a Job that runs a container image and command to completion. The Job is queued and returns `202 Accepted` with the Job object. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

`command` is an array of strings; use `["sh", "-c", "..."]` when you need shell syntax. `env` is an array of `{key, value}` objects. A Job can mount at most one volume.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Recommended. A unique key (ASCII, no spaces, 1-255 characters) generated once per user submit action. Reuse the same key when retrying the same request. Keys are kept for 24 hours per project. Same key and same body returns the original Job (`202` with response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) without creating a new one; same key with a different body returns 422. Without a key, every request creates a new Job.

400.description: Request rejected by the platform. Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` is safe.

403.description: `project_id` does not match the API key's project.

422.description: Validation error, or the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request body.

idempotency_key_mismatch.summary: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body

value.detail: Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body

get.description: Returns the Jobs of the API key's project, optionally filtered by status.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID. Optional - it must match the API key's project; any other value returns 403.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Return only Jobs in this status.

403.description: `project_id` does not match the API key's project.

422.description: Invalid request. For POST /jobs this includes reusing an `Idempotency-Key` with a different request body.

get.description: Returns the status of a Job, including `reason` and `exit_code` once it has finished.

404.description: Job not found in this project.

422.description: Invalid request. For POST /jobs this includes reusing an `Idempotency-Key` with a different request body.

post.description: Request cancellation of a Job. Returns `202` when the cancel request is accepted (status becomes `CANCELLING`, then `CANCELLED`) and `200` when the Job has already finished.

200.description: The Job has already finished; nothing to cancel.

404.description: Job not found in this project.

get.description: Returns stdout/stderr log lines of a Job, newest first. When `has_more` is true, pass `next_offset` as `offset` to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Return only lines containing this text.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of the time range (ISO 8601, timezone required).

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of the time range (ISO 8601, timezone required).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of log lines per page. Min 1, max 5000.

404.description: Job not found in this project.

422.description: Invalid request. For POST /jobs this includes reusing an `Idempotency-Key` with a different request body.

get.description: Returns billed minutes and cost of one Job, with a breakdown by 10-minute interval. Amounts are integer KRW. `amount` is the confirmed charge; `pending_amount` is an estimate for intervals not yet charged and can be higher than the final charge.

404.description: Job not found in this project.

422.description: Invalid request. For POST /jobs this includes reusing an `Idempotency-Key` with a different request body.

502.description: Usage data is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.

example.detail: Usage data is temporarily unavailable. Please retry later.

get.description: Returns the per-Job usage totals of the project for a date range (default: last 30 days, max 92 days). Organization balance and transactions are not available with a project API key; view them in the console.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID. Optional - it must match the API key's project; any other value returns 403.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601 with timezone; encode `+` as `%2B`). Defaults to 30 days before `end_date`.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601 with timezone). Defaults to now. The range may not exceed 92 days.

403.description: `project_id` does not match the API key's project.

422.description: Invalid dates, or the range exceeds 92 days.

502.description: Usage data is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.

example.detail: Usage data is temporarily unavailable. Please retry later.

get.description: Returns the volumes of the project that a Job can mount. Volumes are read-only here; create and delete them in the console. Currently a Job mounts an existing volume attached to an Endpoint.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID. Optional - it must match the API key's project; any other value returns 403.

403.description: `project_id` does not match the API key's project.

422.description: Invalid request. For POST /jobs this includes reusing an `Idempotency-Key` with a different request body.

get.description: Returns a single volume, including the Endpoints and Jobs it is attached to.

404.description: Volume not found in this project.

422.description: Invalid request. For POST /jobs this includes reusing an `Idempotency-Key` with a different request body.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Min 1, max 2000.

bearerAuth.description: Pass your API key as a Bearer token. Create API keys in the project overview.

organization_id.description: Organization ID linked to the API key.

project_id.description: Project ID linked to the API key.

api_key_id.description: API key ID used for authentication.

user_id.description: User ID who created the API key.

is_active.description: Whether the endpoint is currently active (running).

status.description: Current status. When active, fetched in real-time from Ray Serve.

replica_status_summary.description: Replica count by status. Only available when endpoint is active.

container_health_check_timeout.description: Container health check timeout in seconds.

health_check_timeout.description: Overall health check timeout in seconds. Deployment fails if health check does not pass within this time.

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode for the endpoint's public URL. `api_key` requires an AirCloud API key, `oidc` uses OIDC login, and `none` exposes the endpoint without AirCloud authentication.

is_active.description: Active status (always false after successful patch).

auth_mode.description: Current authentication mode for the endpoint's public URL.

node_id.description: Node ID where the replica is running.

start_time_s.description: Replica start time (Unix timestamp in seconds).

node_id.description: Node ID where the log is stored.

filename.description: Log file path. Use as the `filename` parameter in the `/logs/file` API.

is_historical.description: Whether this is a rotated historical log file from a terminated replica.

start_time.description: Log start time. Only available for historical logs.

end_time.description: Log end time. Only available for historical logs.

content.description: Log file content for the specified line range. Each line is a JSON log entry.

ProblemDetails.description: Problem details for the endpoint, following RFC 9457. Present only when the live status lookup failed or the serving application reported an error; the response itself is still 200.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem.

status.description: HTTP status code that corresponds to the problem.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this specific occurrence.

layer.description: Internal layer that produced the problem.

context.description: Additional context for the problem, when available.

project_id.description: Project ID. Optional - defaults to the API key's project.

instance_type_id.description: Instance type ID from the instance types list.

image_is_public.description: Whether the image is public. Set `false` for a private image and provide registry credentials.

registry_username.description: Registry username for a private image.

registry_password.description: Registry password for a private image. Never returned in responses.

registry_region.description: Registry region (for example for AWS ECR).

command.description: Command to run in the container, as an array of strings. The image ENTRYPOINT cannot be overridden.

env.description: Environment variables as an array of `{key, value}` objects. A plain object is rejected with 422.

volume.description: Volume to mount. A Job can mount only one volume.

working_dir.description: Absolute working directory for the command. Defaults to the image's WORKDIR; created if missing.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page. `null` when `has_more` is false.

JobReason.description: Reason for a failed or cancelled Job. `USER_EXIT_NONZERO`: command exited non-zero; `OOM`: out of memory; `IMAGE_PULL`: image pull failed; `CAPACITY_TIMEOUT`: waited more than 900 seconds for resources; `PLATFORM_ERROR` / `PLATFORM_LOST`: infrastructure failure (not restarted automatically; resubmit); `USER_CANCELLED`: cancelled by request; `BALANCE_EXHAUSTED`: cancelled because the prepaid balance ran out.

reason.description: Reason for a failed or cancelled Job. `null` otherwise.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the user's command.

message.description: Human-readable detail about the current status or failure, when available.

status_unknown_since.description: Set when the platform temporarily cannot confirm the Job's state; null otherwise.

JobStatus.description: Job status. Lifecycle: `QUEUED` -> `PENDING` (waiting for resources) -> `STARTING` -> `RUNNING` -> `SUCCEEDED` / `FAILED`; `CANCELLING` -> `CANCELLED` after a cancel request.

billed.description: Whether this interval has been charged.

pending_amount.description: Estimated amount for intervals not yet charged. Can be higher than the final charge.

total_pending_amount.description: Total estimated amount not yet charged.

subpath.description: Subpath inside the volume. Empty string mounts the volume root.

container_path.description: Absolute mount path in the container.

VolumeMountSpec.description: Binds a subpath of the volume to a path in the container.

attached_endpoints.description: Endpoints this volume is attached to.

attached_jobs.description: Jobs this volume is attached to.
